label: Lasting ground (A2ab) from CAUSE_OF_BEING_1 originating causes, contact and no return
description: New non-transcription conditional support option for premise A2ab (lasting ground) of Arrival A. Comparability of moments (linear time) is an explicit open premise, not a type-class restriction, so the route covers every model in which it holds. Let a concrete x be absent at s and present at t > s. It has a concrete originating cause g (CAUSE_OF_BEING_1): x has a first moment b of presence and g gives it being at b, so by contact g is present at b. By comparability b is before s, equal to s or after s. b is not s (x is absent at s); b is not before s, since x would then be present at b and t and absent at s between them, against convexity; so b is after s, and g is a ground of x present after s. No sustaining causation is used. On the inclusive reading of GivesAt (causing coming to be counts) this route is open to an existential-inertia theorist who grants originating causes, contact and no return; on the strict esse-giving reading that is not shown. On this formulation convexity and comparability enter because the originating cause acts at the first moment of presence overall; an originating premise tied to the first moment after the absence would need only contact and grounds (not formalized). The originating premise requires a first moment of presence for every beginning thing. Convexity is needed: intermittent presence satisfies the other premises and falsifies A2ab (Control part 6); all premises hold nonvacuously with A2ab (part 7). Whether comparability is needed is not checked. All premises stay OPEN. No premise is established.
